connections.note: main power in; battery mounts low and centered on the frame so its mass sits at the centre of gravity
ESCs mount on the arms close to their motors, keeping power runs short and the centre plate uncluttered
wire order sets spin direction together with the CW/CCW motor pairing; swap any two wires to reverse a motor
the module sits in line with the main lead so the FC can sense pack voltage and current
bind the transmitter before the first powered test, and do every bench power-up with props off
diagonal motor pairs share a spin direction in an X quad; match each output to the corner the configurator expects
balance mode, charged off the aircraft; both list packs sequentially on an 80W-class charger

orientation: X-quad layout: diagonal motor pairs spin the same direction; CW props go on CW motors, CCW on CCW — the motor and prop sets in the list are both sold as matched CW/CCW sets for this.
Flight controller arrow points at the frame's front; mount it on the centre plate, level, away from the PDB's high-current runs.
Battery sits low and centred, connector toward the rear for easy plug access without shifting the CG.
Receiver antennas exit at angles away from carbon and power leads; keep them off the arms' ESC wiring.
